# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.43 (pre-release)

Fixes for bugs found by a tester in pre.41/pre.42 (on top of the published pre.42). Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine. The automated tests pass on CI runners for Linux, Windows and macOS. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**Read before upgrading**
- Defaults unchanged. Project files may now carry `pageN.page_ocr_zones` and `pageN.page_ocr_ignore`; older versions skip lines they do not know and would silently lose them.

**Fixed**
- **OCR pencils** drew on every page; a zone or ignored area now belongs to the page it was drawn on and is read only for it. A page with its own zones uses them instead of the general ones; ignored areas add up. Right-click removes the rectangle under the cursor; Undo works.
- **Content box** did not show while an OCR pencil was active; the box and the pencils now exclude each other, visibly.
- **Keystone sliders** changed both pages of a cut sheet; with a page selected they change that page only.
- **Right page**: the OCR pencil could not be applied on the right page of a cut sheet (the left page's cell ended the drag first); fixed. The page under the mouse is now selected automatically, so every tool and setting follows it.
- **Output mode** (gray, black-and-white, mixed) and clean-up were per page in the engine but looked universal because the selector stayed on "All pages". A click on a processed page now selects it (blue frame) and Output, Clean-up, keystone, box and pencils follow it.

**New**: version bump, guides (all languages) and READMEs describe page selection by click.

**Verified**: fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, engine and GUI tests, new project round-trip test and thread-local OCR region test. **Not verified**: the new clicks and pencils in the real window, by hand; Windows, macOS, arm64. The macOS Intel runner (experimental) fails two PKCS#12 tests unrelated to this change.
